posts.note: Live on the Chrome Web Store. Scores any site's data ethics and shows you GDPR-friendly European alternatives to the tools you're already using.
posts.about: A data-ethics score for any website you visit, plus European alternatives to the SaaS tools you rely on. Built after digging into the EU's push for tech sovereignty and what countries like Germany and France are doing to reduce dependence on non-European infrastructure. Runs entirely locally — nothing you browse gets sent anywhere.
posts.author: Iona

posts.note: Community-powered shipping — senders get matched with travelers already heading their way.
posts.about: CrowdWave connects people who need to send a package with travelers who have spare space on a route they're already taking. Senders post package details and destination, travelers post their route, and a matching algorithm pairs them in real time. Senders save up to 70% versus traditional couriers, travelers earn on each delivery, and the shipment produces no extra vehicle trip. Trust runs on government-ID verification, two-way ratings, encrypted payments, and real-time tracking with photo proof of delivery. The app is currently in testing on iOS and Android — not yet published.
posts.author: Iona
